# Gaming Setup Script for Windows 11 Pro 24H2 # Optimized for Discord, Spotify, Steam, and multitasking
Write-Host "Applying Gaming Optimizations for Windows 11 Pro 24H2..." -ForegroundColor Green
# Create and apply gaming registry optimizations $GamingOptimizations = @" Windows Registry Editor Version 5.00
; == ACCESSIBILITY SETTINGS - DISABLE FOR GAMING == ; Disable Narrator completely [HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Narrator\NoRoam] "DuckAudio"=dword:00000000 "WinEnterLaunchEnabled"=dword:00000000 "ScriptingEnabled"=dword:00000000 "OnlineServicesEnabled"=dword:00000000 "EchoToggleKeys"=dword:00000000
[HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Narrator] "NarratorCursorHighlight"=dword:00000000 "CoupleNarratorCursorKeyboard"=dword:00000000 "IntonationPause"=dword:00000000 "ReadHints"=dword:00000000 "ErrorNotificationType"=dword:00000000 "EchoChars"=dword:00000000 "EchoWords"=dword:00000000
[HKEY_CURRENT_USER\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Narrator\NarratorHome] "MinimizeType"=dword:00000000 "AutoStart"=dword:00000000
; Disable accessibility sounds and warnings [HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Control Panel\Accessibility] "Sound on Activation"=dword:00000000 "Warning Sounds"=dword:00000000
; Disable StickyKeys [HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Control Panel\Accessibility\StickyKeys] "Flags"="2"
; Disable ToggleKeys [HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Control Panel\Accessibility\ToggleKeys] "Flags"="34"
; Disable FilterKeys/Keyboard Response [HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Control Panel\Accessibility\Keyboard Response] "Flags"="2" "AutoRepeatRate"="0" "AutoRepeatDelay"="0"
; Disable SoundSentry (visual alerts) [HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Control Panel\Accessibility\SoundSentry] "Flags"="0" "FSTextEffect"="0" "TextEffect"="0" "WindowsEffect"="0"
; == GAMING OPTIMIZATIONS == ; Disable Xbox GameDVR for better performance [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\GameDVR] "AllowGameDVR"=dword:00000000
[HKEY_CURRENT_USER\System\GameConfigStore] "GameDVR_Enabled"=dword:00000000
; Enable Game Mode [HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\GameBar] "UseNexusForGameBarEnabled"=dword:00000000 "AutoGameModeEnabled"=dword:00000001
; Disable Game Bar hotkeys that can interfere with gaming [HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\GameDVR] "AppCaptureEnabled"=dword:00000000 "VKToggleGameBar"=dword:00000000 "VKMToggleGameBar"=dword:00000000
; Optimize DirectX for windowed games [HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\DirectX\UserGpuPreferences] "DirectXUserGlobalSettings"="SwapEffectUpgradeEnable=1;VRROptimizeEnable=0;"
; == PRIVACY & TELEMETRY == ; Disable Activity History [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System] "EnableActivityFeed"=dword:00000000 "PublishUserActivities"=dword:00000000 "UploadUserActivities"=dword:00000000
; Disable Advertising ID [HKEY_CURRENT_USER\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\AdvertisingInfo] "Enabled"=dword:00000000
; Minimize Telemetry (Security level for Pro) [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection] "AllowTelemetry"=dword:00000001 "DoNotShowFeedbackNotifications"=dword:00000001
; Disable Location Services [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\LocationAndSensors] "DisableLocation"=dword:00000001
; == WINDOWS UPDATE - GAMING FOCUSED == ; Disable automatic restarts during gaming hours [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate\AU] "NoAutoRebootWithLoggedOnUsers"=dword:00000001
; Prevent Windows 11 25H2 auto-upgrade [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate] "TargetReleaseVersion"=dword:00000001 "TargetReleaseVersionInfo"="24H2"
; Disable Delivery Optimization to prevent bandwidth usage during gaming [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DeliveryOptimization] "DODownloadMode"=dword:00000000
; == DISABLE BLOATWARE FEATURES == ; Disable Windows Copilot [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsCopilot] "TurnOffWindowsCopilot"=dword:00000001
; Disable Cortana [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Search] "AllowCortana"=dword:00000000
; Disable News and Interests [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Dsh] "AllowNewsAndInterests"=dword:00000000
; Disable BitLocker auto-encryption (can impact gaming performance) [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\BitLocker] "PreventDeviceEncryption"=dword:00000001
; == UI OPTIMIZATIONS FOR GAMING == ; Disable Tablet Mode [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ImmersiveShell] "TabletMode"=dword:00000000 "SignInMode"=dword:00000001
; Hide Chat Icon [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Chat] "ChatIcon"=dword:00000003
; Disable Notifications during gaming [HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\PushNotifications] "ToastEnabled"=dword:00000000
"@
Set-Content -Path "$env:TEMP\GamingOptimizations.reg" -Value $GamingOptimizations -Force Regedit.exe /S "$env:TEMP\GamingOptimizations.reg"
# Remove common bloatware apps Write-Host "Removing bloatware applications..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
$AppsToRemove = @( 'Microsoft.BingNews', 'Microsoft.BingWeather', 'Microsoft.GamingApp', 'Microsoft.GetHelp', 'Microsoft.Getstarted', 'Microsoft.MicrosoftOfficeHub', 'Microsoft.MicrosoftSolitaireCollection', 'Microsoft.People', 'Microsoft.PowerAutomateDesktop', 'Microsoft.StorePurchaseApp', 'Microsoft.Teams', 'Microsoft.Todos', 'Microsoft.WindowsAlarms', 'Microsoft.WindowsCamera', 'Microsoft.WindowsFeedbackHub', 'Microsoft.WindowsMaps', 'Microsoft.WindowsSoundRecorder', 'Microsoft.Xbox.TCUI', 'Microsoft.XboxApp', 'Microsoft.XboxGameOverlay', 'Microsoft.XboxGamingOverlay', 'Microsoft.XboxIdentityProvider', 'Microsoft.XboxSpeechToTextOverlay', 'Microsoft.ZuneMusic', 'Microsoft.ZuneVideo' )
foreach ($App in $AppsToRemove) { try { Get-AppxPackage -Name $App -AllUsers | Remove-AppxPackage -AllUsers -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue Get-AppxProvisionedPackage -Online | Where-Object DisplayName -EQ $App | Remove-AppxProvisionedPackage -Online -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch { # Silent fail for apps that don't exist } }
# Set services optimal for gaming Write-Host "Optimizing services for gaming..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
$ServicesToDisable = @( 'DiagTrack', 'dmwappushservice', 'Fax', 'XblAuthManager', 'XblGameSave', 'XboxNetApiSvc' )
foreach ($Service in $ServicesToDisable) { try { Set-Service -Name $Service -StartupType Disabled -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue Stop-Service -Name $Service -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch { # Silent fail for services that don't exist } }
Write-Host "Gaming optimizations applied successfully!" -ForegroundColor Green Write-Host "System optimized for Discord, Spotify, Steam, and multitasking on Windows 11 Pro 24H2" -ForegroundColor Green
